reason: The user was authenticated via name+zip (find_user_id_by_name_zip) and get_user_details confirmed order #W7043598 belongs to this user. get_order_details is a read-only information lookup, not a database-updating action (cancel, modify, return, exchange), so the policy's requirement to list action details and obtain explicit confirmation does not apply. The user explicitly asked the agent to pull up order details since they could not recall which order had the office/hiking items, which is exactly the information-lookup assistance the policy permits post-authentication.
policy_references: Once the user has been authenticated, you can provide the user with information about order, product, profile information, e.g. help the user look up order id.
Before taking any action that updates the database (cancel, modify, return, exchange), you must list the action details and obtain explicit user confirmation (yes) to proceed.
